calculation.description: At each date, rank the negative three-day return residual versus the cross-sectional median, scaled by each instrument's trailing 30-day daily-return volatility. Inputs are lagged through the completed date; no forward data enters the signal.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC and ICIR in all three evaluated regimes, with moderated performance in 2025-2026. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation. The signal is highly correlated with existing residual-reversal artifacts and may be quarantined by the deterministic library audit despite passing standalone IC gates.
